# @stackline/dev-null

Maintained zero-dependency Node.js Writable sink compatible with dev-null@0.1.1.

Install: npm install @stackline/dev-null
Alias: npm install dev-null@npm:@stackline/dev-null
Version: {{PACKAGE_VERSION}}
Runtime: Node.js 12+
Dependencies: zero

Docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/dev-null/
Migration: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/dev-null/guides/migration.md
Compatibility: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/dev-null/guides/compatibility.md
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/dev-null
